title: Guides and static pages carry lastModified in the sitemap
detail:
Guides carry real PUBLISHED and UPDATED dates but the sitemap emits none. Export GUIDE_LAST_MODIFIED from the guide dates and use it in staticRoutes.

Closed 2026-10-26: lib/seo/guide-dates.ts holds each guide's dates; the pages' structured data and the sitemap's lastModified read it.
